releases.displayName: The Ambulance Update is OUT NOW!

notes.title: We’re excited to announce that our highly requested Ambulance Update is officially OUT NOW!

items.text: The new system allows officers to provide first aid to injured civilians encountered while on patrol. Some injuries are minor and require a quick on-the-spot assessment, while more serious cases demand urgent stabilization through a timed minigame before the patient can be transported to hospital.
Ambulances can be called to the scene to transport patients, while Coroner vans will attend to fatalities. Both vehicles are fully usable by the player.
Entering an Ambulance or Coroner Van activates new vehicle-specific callouts, placing you temporarily in the role of a Paramedic or Coroner tasked with handling medical incidents across the city.

This update also introduces a new collectable activity: Narcotic Stashes. Hidden drug drops have begun appearing throughout Averno City, and it's up to officers to track them down and confiscate them.

notes.title: Here are the main additions in this update

items.text: Ambulance/Coroner
Player can enter an Ambulance and respond to Medical Callouts.
Player can enter a Coroner Van and respond to Coroner Dispatch Callouts.
Ambulance can be called for injured civilians.
Coroner can be called to take away dead bodies.
Added occasional Medical Callouts that require first response from Police.
Player can don a Paramedic outfit at the Ambulance
Player can don a Coroner outfit at the Coroner Van.
Added new Hospital and Morgue to West Island.
Gameplay
Added new collectable Narcotic Stashes, unlocked at Police Officer 7 rank.
Police AI can pull suspects out of hiding spots.
Can change outfits from the trunk of Patrol Vehicles.
Music
New Ambulance tracks have been added to the game and soundtrack DLC
We’d like to say a huge thank you to all ACPD officers for your continued support. Without you, none of this would be possible! Check out the new trailer here:
If you do experience any bugs or have any feedback about this update, please let us on the Steam Forums or in our Discord.

releases.displayName: The K-9 Update is OUT NOW!

notes.title: “You must treat our four-legged friends with the same respect you’d afford to any fellow officer” - The Chief

items.text: We’re excited to announce that our long-awaited K-9 Update is officially OUT NOW!

The new K-9 system lets officers deploy a fully trained working dog from the precinct kennels. Your partner can be washed, fed and customized there — breed, harness, collars and more — before heading out on patrol. The dog will obey commands, ranging from subduing dangerous attackers, pursuing fleeing suspects, or sniffing out concealed narcotics.

A new callout tasks your K-9 with tracking a wanted suspect using a recovered scrap of clothing. If you're on duty without a dog, you can summon a K-9 unit as backup via your radio. A purpose-built Station Wagon variant offers dedicated transport, though the dog will readily ride shotgun in any patrol car!
Alongside the new K-9 system, we’ve added the following quality of life changes to this update:
Added an XP penalty for putting a suspect on tracks for a train collision
Added collisions to the Longmile Bridge to prevent helicopter clipping issues
Drivers now leave overturned vehicles more quickly
Boosted traffic light effects to make them more noticeable
Added an unmarked livery for Police Pickup Truck.
Added an unmarked livery for Police Buzzard.
Dispatch can now request backup from the player to support other officers.
Suspects can now hide in portable toilets.
Additional ranks added with new unlocks (Ranks PO26-PO30).
Civilians can now carry briefcases and handbags.

releases.displayName: Introducing Our Second Free Content Update!

notes.title: You spoke, we listened.

items.text: Abandoned vehicles can now be cleared from the streets, allowing traffic to flow freely once again. Summon a Tow Truck, and the obstruction will be dealt with immediately. Offending vehicles can be sent to the city impound, the salvage yard, or - if tied to criminal activity- the Forensic Unit for analysis.
Watch the trailer here 👇
Tow Truck Shift Assignment

But that’s not all. We’ve added a new shift assignment, ‘Tow Detail’. Pull on the gloves and coveralls, and our new Traffic Dispatch operator will assign tow objectives around the city. A slower change of pace, ideal for when you need a break from high-octane activities!
Salvage Yard Machinery
The new salvage yard location features heavy-duty industrial machinery:
A magnetic crane for lifting scrapped vehicles
A vehicle compactor for turning them into cubes of metal
Warning: This machinery is dangerous and should be used with extreme caution to avoid risk of injury to operators or to the public.
The ACPD Tow Truck can, of course, be outfitted with the six liveries released in our last update.
New Lightbars

Further, we are proud to introduce a suite of exciting new lightbar configurations to explore and personalise your vehicle - or all vehicles with. Mix and match with liveries to find your favorite combinations.
Unmarked Patrol Vehicles

Also by popular demand, players can now utilise an Unmarked Patrol Vehicle. This (and plain clothes outfits) will allow officers to remain undetected for longer. These vehicles use concealed lights on the dashboard, rear deck, and grille.
New Clothing Customizations
To support Tow Truck roleplay, players now have two new clothing options to choose between:
Reflective Vest
Coveralls
Kelly has also been provided a snazzy plain clothes outfit, which will be automatically assigned when the player chooses this option. No more blown cover!
New Music Track
Finally, this update also introduces a new music track by Gavin Harrison, ‘Wrecker Blues’, now included in the digital soundtrack.

releases.displayName: We've Released a Small Patch for Our Demo [Build No. 12729]

notes.title: Changes

items.text: First of all, we'd like to say thank you so much to all of you who have taken the time to play our new demo!

We've really appreciated all of your kind words, feedback, and continuing enthusiasm for The Precinct. Thanks to your bug reports and feedback, we've been able to implement a few small fixes and quality of life changes to our demo.
Here are the patch notes for the demo update [build number 12729]:
Fixes for Ultrawide resolutions for handbook & callout complete panel
Fix for PS4 controller allowing accelerate/brake on stick
Fix for some high end PCs defaulting to Low Quality
Fix for FPS cap behaviour when the game is paused and Vsync is disabled
Split Vsync and FPS cap options in graphics menu
Hard coded default quality presets for popular graphics cards
Adjusted void used in interiors
Removed some world chunks of west island from the build (so some sneaky "hackers" can no longer access the whole map)

If you haven't done it already already, we'd really appreciate it if you could leave a review for our demo store page (shown below), post any bugs you've found in the Steam Forum or our Discord, and let us know your honest feedback.
All of this will go towards helping us improve the final game!
